description:
One wallet's lending record, found by address, GONDI username or ENS
name: per currency the principal lent, realised net profit, weighted net
APR, the principal of its defaulted positions, and its open positions
with the interest they are still due to earn, and gondi_url, the
wallet's profile on its Lent tab, which lists those positions. Leave
`currency` unset to get every currency the wallet lent in from one call;
no need to resolve the name or to try the currencies one by one. For
the positions one by one, call list_lender_loans.

currency.description: Only this principal currency; every currency the wallet ever lent in if unset.
currency.title: Currency

wallet.description: The lender: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_lender_returns

LenderReturns.description:
The fields up to `weighted_net_effective_apr_percent` cover every position
the wallet funded in the currency, the `defaulted_` ones its defaulted
positions, and the rest only its open ones. Net means after the protocol
fee, the APRs are weighted by principal and time, and the effective one
counts origination fees. `net_profit` is interest and origination fees from
positions repaid or refinanced out; a defaulted position adds nothing to it,
neither the principal lost nor the NFT received, which is what
`defaulted_principal` is for.
LenderReturns.title: LenderReturns

outputSchema.description:
One wallet's lending record, a `LenderReturns` per currency. Asked without
a currency, `returns` holds only the currencies the wallet ever funded a
position in, so an empty list means it never lent on GONDI.

gondi_url.description: The wallet's GONDI profile on its Lent tab, its loans as lender.
gondi_url.title: Gondi Url

wallet_address.description: The wallet the returns belong to.
wallet_address.title: Wallet Address

wallet_name.description: The name the address was resolved from; null when the call passed an address.
wallet_name.title: Wallet Name

outputSchema.title: WalletLenderReturns

title: Lender returns
